notes.title: Mad Smartphone Tycoon – New Version Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's Muradin!

The all-new version of Mad Smartphone Tycoon is live! We've got the Talent Market and Furniture Store, as previously announced, plus a slew of optimizations and tweaks based on your feedback. I hope these new features and improvements bring even more fun and challenges to your gaming experience! Check out the detailed updates below:

Highlights

 New: Wireless Earbuds Design, Development, and Sales: Starting from 2017, you can unlock and sell trendy wireless earbuds, opening up new business opportunities!
 New: Talent Market: Periodically, you can choose the right employees from the talent market based on your company's R&D needs and development strategies to build your professional team.
 New: Furniture Store: Players can purchase unlimited basic furniture from the furniture store, enhancing the company environment and boosting employee efficiency. Decorate your smartphone company to your heart's content.

Optimizations & Adjustments

 Flashlight added to phones
 Sandbox mode now allows unlimited object placement
 Phone pricing and naming can now be decided after confirming R&D
 Adjusted phone component placement, added value input boxes for more precise adjustments
 Fan count now changes even when phones aren’t being sold
 Added new achievements
 Fixed issue where self-developed hardware prices weren’t affected by R&D scores
 Various value adjustments...


As an indie developer, I really appreciate all your support. If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to join our community and share them with me. Also, if you encounter any issues while playing, please join the community and let me know so I can understand and resolve your problems more quickly and directly.

Thanks again for your support and understanding! 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update Preview: New Features Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey there, smartphone tycoons!

Super excited to share some great news with you all: Mad Smartphone Tycoon is getting a new update in early November! This update brings two new features to make your smartphone empire even more magnificent!

🌟 Furniture Market: In the Furniture Market, you can buy various basic furniture items to decorate your smartphone company. Plus, these items come with different attributes to help you during your startup phase, such as increasing base sales and boosting staff efficiency. Smartly combining these items will drive the growth of your smartphone business empire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978986/5b7fb8bab5493605ff78f2b5a3a4afd95b92b4c7.png

👥 Talent Market: Looking to build a powerful team? The Talent Market gives you the chance to choose your employees. You can recruit the best-suited employees from the market based on your company's research needs and development strategies, enhancing your company's efficiency and competitiveness!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978986/7a0a90bc85f32263b896e5967e3dc64688ea5fe6.png

I hope these new features bring more fun and challenges to your gaming experience! Besides these new features, I've also updated and optimized the existing content, including new maps, more sellable devices, more random events, and more customizable appearances. Stay tuned! The new version will be available in early November!

As an indie developer, I really appreciate all your support. If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to join our community and share them with me. Also, if you encounter any issues while playing, please join the community and let me know so I can understand and resolve your problems more quickly and directly.

Thanks again for your support and understanding! 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: New Update Alert! Sandbox Mode is Available Now
notes.notes:
Hey there, smartphone tycoons!

We've got some exciting news for you! Mad Smartphone Tycoon just got a brand-new game mode – Sandbox Mode! In this mode, you can let your creativity run wild with no restrictions and fully enjoy building your own smartphone empire! Plus, we've made a bunch of content optimizations. Here are the details:

Sandbox Mode Highlights:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978986/55c19f4a76acdb41bf8083e55ded55fa79c50446.png

 Unlimited Resources: Start with infinite money and resources, including staff and items!
 Free Customization: No task pressure, freely design your phones and research hardware!
 Endless Challenges: No fixed goals, but you can keep pushing the limits to create your own tech business kingdom.

Please note, Sandbox Mode needs to be started in a new save file and won't affect your existing progress or data.

Hot Phone Designs 2.0

Based on your feedback, we've optimized the hot phone designs and turned them into a new feature called "Outsourcing Order." Complete these orders in-game to earn funds!

Other Additions & Optimizations

 Added a "Skip" button to the employee inspiration interface.
 Lowered early game difficulty to reduce the chance of bankruptcy.
 You can now freely choose hardware quality when developing your own hardware. The higher the hardware score during development, the lower the cost of the developed hardware.
 When developing a new phone, the name will be based on the previous phone's name.
 When loading a save, the phone development page will automatically load the appearance and configuration of the last phone.
 Increased the maximum level cap in the main menu's "Buy Upgrades".

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where some appearance attributes were not imported when importing historical phone configurations.
 Fixed an issue where the "Veneer" material was not displaying clearly.

As a solo indie developer, I want to thank everyone for your support. I'll continue to add more new features and gameplay in the future, including new maps, more sellable devices, more random events, and more customizable appearances. If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to join our community and share them with me. If you encounter any issues while playing, please join the community and let me know so I can understand and resolve your problems more quickly and directly.

Thanks again for your support and understanding! 
Happy gaming!

notes.title: V0.85.3.2 Version Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Tycoons

Thank you all for your continued support and valuable feedback. As an independent game developer, I will continue to update and optimize the game to address the issues you encounter. Below are the details of the new version update:

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed an issue where some achievements could not be unlocked.
- Fixed the problem of competitor stock prices remaining unchanged after 2025.
- Fixed the issue of competitors not releasing new phones after 2025.
- Fixed the problem of not paying severance when terminating employees.
- Fixed the issue where developing proprietary hardware did not consume funds.

Optimizations:

- Reduced office rental costs on city maps.
- Increased the number of items in stores from 4 to 8.
- Adjusted the award thresholds for some categories at the annual awards ceremony.
- Removed the option to purchase research points from the store.
- Increased sales when promoting phones.

Currently, I am working on creating and optimizing the sandbox mode, which is expected to be updated soon. If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to join the Discord to share them with me. Additionally, if you encounter any problems during gameplay, please join the community to communicate with me directly, allowing me to understand and solve the issues more quickly.

Thank you again for your support and understanding!
Enjoy the game!
